summary.en: Syrian internal security forces have arrested former regime officer Ahmad Raslan, Lieutenant Ahmed Talal Rslan over the al-Ateeba ambush, and a deposed regime officer linked to the al-Otaiba massacre. Two young men were killed by a landmine and another young man died in a war-remnant explosion while herding livestock in the Aleppo countryside. Syria, Jordan, Iraq and Lebanon have signed a pact to bolster food security. Over 23,000 children have been killed during the civil war, according to a monitor, and there were 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske interne sikkerhetsstyrker har arrestert den tidligere regjeringsoffiseren Ahmad Raslan, løytnant Ahmed Talal Rslan i forbindelse med al-Ateeba-ambushen, og en avsatt regjeringsoffiser knyttet til al-Otaiba-massakren. To unge menn ble drept av en landmine, og en annen ung mann døde i en eksplosjon fra krigsgjenstander mens han gjette husdyr på landsbygda utenfor Aleppo. Syria, Jordan, Irak og Libanon har signert en avtale for å styrke matsikkerheten. Over 23 000 barn har blitt drept under borgerkrigen, ifølge en monitor, og det var 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
